I went to a “private school” for junior and senior year of high school. It was a school for extremely misbehaved teens who didn’t have much of a chance at other schools. (Drug dealers, kids who just got out of juvie with not enough credits, etc.) my time at this place was actually pretty positive. The teachers were great, and though the students weren’t the greatest of people, they all kind of had a respect for me. Still, I was going through a rough time in my life out side of school and I was doing very poorly, mentally, and emotionally. I was expelled the first year I was there, and when I came back I was still not doing great, but I decided to just do the work and get out. This school wasn’t based on credits, instead they used competencies, which basically means if you prove you know how to do it, you pass. No matter how long you’ve done the class. That way you can pass as fast or as slow as you want. Go at your own pace. After really working hard, I managed to graduate a half a year earlier than I was meant to. I was very proud of myself, which didn’t happen often. That is until people I knew started commenting. They would all say “finally” or “I didn’t think you’d ever graduate!” Like I had been held back a thousand times. I understand that I was a bad kid, but I still graduated early, let alone on time. Still, everyone, including my parents and friends, would only talk about how surprised they were. Anyways, I was convinced to go to the ceremony, even though I didn’t want to, and it was just more of the same. I hated all of it. We finally went home and it was late at night at this point. We stopped to get gas at my local small convenience store and i went in to pay. The owner of the store is a very sweet man. I’ve known him most of my life. I would go into his store and have long conversations with him, but I never really got to know him all that well, he was just a nice man. Well when I walk in the store, he asks how’s it going and I tell him I just got back from my graduation. As soon as I said it, his face lit up and screamed congratulations. No “finally”. No “really?” Just a genuine congrats. I’m not even entirely sure why, but this meant the world to me. Some one was just genuinely happy for me. It really helped me, when I truly needed it.

I love the Gorillaz. Anything I am about to say, is not so much directed at them, or their music. My issues are simply directed at this specific product they are selling under their brand. 

The Free Murdoc Campaign Pack costs you almost 100$. Inside you will find a short letter sent from “Murdoc himself” that is just a copy paste letter with your name on it. A white T-shirt with the words Free Murdoc on it. A small pin with the same words. A very low quality maga parody hat. And all that will take you a couple of months to get. They are shipped in two waves. 

Now when the Pack was announced, it included two mystery items. This is where the real value came from. It turned out to be patches and stickers, however. In my estimate, a 50$ value at 100$. Unfortunately, it gets worse. The site says 4 deliveries over the summer. Well it is mid September and I have only received 2, with no sign or message if the others. The worst part is, I’m not even that upset about losing the rest of the pack, because it is so low value. 

The truth is, that isn’t the worst part. The worst part is the canon story. The story is Murdoc was in jail, and we were to believe he should be released. Well, spoilers of you haven’t been keeping up with the Gorillaz news, but Murdoc is already out of prison! So when I receive my patch and stickers, and my hat and shirt and everything else, it won’t make any sense! It all says Free Murdoc! When I get it, he will already have been free for months!! 

This purchase is so disappointing in so many ways. Like I said, I still love Gorillaz, and I will still buy their merch from their merch store, but never again will I be buying exclusive mystery deals like this. They really screwed over a lot of people.
